item.title: Unoccupied derelict building, 8th September
item.description:
St Mary’s nursing home at the end of St Margaret’s Avenue in sidcup has been unoccupied for several years and recently has been broken into numerous times and I have seen children breaking inside in the evenings. They have smashed windows and trashed it. The fences all around have been broken and smashed down and fly tippers are constantly dumping rubbish here. It is extremely dangerous and a health hazard and whoever still owns it has a responsibility to keep it secure . Why should I have to look at this eye sore at the end of my road…you have a duty of care to your residents and it needs sorting before someone gets hurt or sets fire to it …
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 327, Main Road, Longlands, Sidcup, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
